title: Detect machine stoppages and micro-stops from state-change events in an Eventhouse
summary: KQL for a Fabric Eventhouse that turns machine state-change events into stop intervals with duration, flags open stops that are still running, and splits stoppages from micro-stops with a clear boundary rule.

title: OEE availability per machine and day from state events with shift window and midnight split
summary: KQL for a Fabric Eventhouse that cuts state intervals at midnight, clips them to a shift window and computes availability per machine and day, with a coverage column that exposes missing data.

title: Vibration anomaly detection per machine with make-series and a z-score baseline in KQL
summary: Two KQL approaches for machine vibration in a Fabric Eventhouse: series_decompose_anomalies on an hourly series and a plain z-score against a reference period, with a checked example and gap handling.

title: Cycle time outlier detection per machine and part with a leave-one-out baseline in KQL
summary: KQL that flags slow machine cycles against the other cycles of the same machine and part, using a leave-one-out z-score that works in small groups, with comparison to the ideal cycle time and a hand-checked example.

title: Sensor drift between redundant probes with series_fit_line in a Fabric Eventhouse
summary: KQL that compares two redundant sensors per asset, builds a daily difference series and uses series_fit_line slope and rsquare to separate slow drift from random scatter, with a verified numeric example.

title: MTBF and MTTR per machine from downtime events with window clipping in KQL
summary: KQL for a Fabric Eventhouse that computes MTBF, MTTR and inherent availability per machine from downtime events, clips events at the reporting window, handles open events and keeps machines without failures.
